title: fix(plugin-form): a master-detail header keystroke is no longer dropped while the page has other work pending

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuL9peF3uJZUvBPnozyR5Esc)_

Fixes #28471

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：主从表单（showcase「New Project + Tasks」这类）表头里打的字不会再被吞掉；live 规格在点 Create 前先确认名字还在输入框里。
- 为什么改：表单宿主上抓表头值给明细行的原生监听比 React 先拿到按键，它的状态更新是同步优先级，浏览器在两个监听器之间把它连同页面别的待处理更新一起渲染，表头输入框被写回旧值，按键就丢了，Create 报「Project Name is required」、不发请求。CI 两次红就是这个，后端没问题。
- 风险与回滚：只改一处，明细行接表头值的那次更新改成 transition（晚一拍渲染，表头不受影响）；回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`（`MasterDetailLines` 里的 `startTransition`）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.headerKeystrokePendingWork-28471.test.tsx`、`ui/e2e/live/master-detail.spec.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --root . packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.headerKeystrokePendingWork-28471.test.tsx`，预期 1 个用例绿（表头打的 `paid` 留在输入框里，明细行的 Qty 随之锁定）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Product fix (`@object-ui/plugin-form`).** `MasterDetailLines` reads the header's edits by listening to `input` / `change` on the form host and scraping the named controls, so the line grids' `parent` record follows the header. The host is inside the React root, so its native listener runs before React's root listener has passed the keystroke to the header's react-hook-form. Its `setEditedRecord` was priced by `window.event` (`input`), i.e. sync priority. The browser runs a microtask checkpoint after each listener, React flushes its sync work there, and React 19.3 renders pending default-priority lanes in the same pass (`getHighestPriorityLanes`: `lanes & 42` = Sync | InputContinuous | Default). When the page had such work pending (a fetch that had just answered), that render reached the header `ObjectForm` (not memoized), and the commit wrote the input's old controlled value `""` back through React's value tracker. React's change plugin then saw no change and never called `onChange`: the keystroke was dropped, the input went blank, and the Create click was refused by the required-field check without a request. The update is now `startTransition(() => setEditedRecord(next))`; a transition is not flushed in that checkpoint, so React reads the keystroke first. The lines still update right after.

**Spec.** `master-detail.spec.ts` checks `input[name="name"]` still holds the typed name before it clicks Create, in both Create tests. With the defect back, the failure now names the dropped value at that line instead of a 15 s `waitForResponse` timeout. No wait, timeout or retry changed.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/28471-master-detail-header-keystroke.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-zka32v`, not `claude/issue-28471-*`; the card is #28471.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.headerKeystrokePendingWork-28471.test.tsx` (new, 1): a page re-render is scheduled outside `act` (a real default-priority update), then a keystroke is delivered the way a browser does. happy-dom leaves out two browser behaviours the defect needs, so the test supplies them: `window.event` is defined for the dispatch, and a bubble listener on the element right under the React root container calls `flushSync()` where the browser's checkpoint falls. Asserts the header input still holds the value and the `readonlyWhen: parent.status == 'paid'` cell locks.
- `ui/e2e/live/master-detail.spec.ts`: the two `toHaveValue(name)` checks above.

## Acceptance notes

- Root cause class: (a) in the card's terms, a click on a form that was not ready to submit, and the reason it was not ready is a product defect: a real user typing into a master-detail header while the page settles loses the keystroke the same way. Not (b): the click provoked no request at all. Not (c): no request reached the backend.
- The failure-artifact zips of runs 41222427173 / 41239207302 could not be downloaded from the cloud container (the artifact host answers 403 to the proxy CONNECT), so the cause was reproduced locally with the CI build and backend instead.
- Out of scope, not touched: `apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx` also adds a native `input` listener (document, capture phase); it was not examined for the same pattern.

## Verification

Head `409e49ef`, base `768ec4bf` (current `main` at branch time). Rig: the CI `Live E2E UI` setup on private ports (`ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` on the showcase example, console built with `VITE_BASE_PATH=/ vite build`, `vite preview` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`), Chromium from `/opt/pw-browsers`, `--retries 0`, 1 worker.

<details><summary>How the cause was found</summary>

- CPU throttled with CDP `Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate`. In every failing run the name input was empty at the click with "Project Name is required" shown, account and status intact, the button enabled, no batch request.
- An init script wrapped every `input` listener: the value was still typed after the window, body and root capture listeners and after the host's scrape listener, and was `""` after the microtask that followed the scrape listener, before React's root bubble listener ran.
- A hook on the input's value setter, matched by element identity, caught the write: `updateInput` / `commitHostUpdate` / `commitRoot` / `performSyncWorkOnRoot` / `processRootScheduleInMicrotask`.
- A `__REACT_DEVTOOLS_GLOBAL_HOOK__.onCommitFiberRoot` probe showed that commit re-rendering from above `RouteElement` down through `MasterDetailForm` and `ObjectForm` to the input (page work batched into the sync flush). Passing runs had the same scrape listener but no page work pending at that instant.

</details>
